lines.4: I held forth to my childhood-friend crew on the wonders of love.
lines.7: 「Did you seriously gather us here just to brag about your love life?!」
lines.8: 「You're the one who said I've been neglecting you guys and should let you use my room.」
lines.9: 「Damn it... Hey, think Otome might introduce me to one of her friends?」
lines.14: Crab slammed the window shut and stormed out.
lines.19: 「Well, the school trip and everything means expenses are piling up.」
lines.21: 「Miss Crab, drinking alcohol is NOT GOOD. And straight from bottle, TOO?」
lines.23: 「Oh, finally found you... I spent hours looking when you wouldn't answer your phone... So here you are.」
lines.24: 「You are Miss Crab's FRIEND, yes? She got so wild, I could not HANDLE her.」
lines.25: 「Sorry about the trouble. I'll take her off your hands.」
lines.26: 「Please DO. Is okay, I take cost from Miss Crab's PAYCHECK.」
lines.27: 「Oh, Subaru? You drink too! C'mon, drink!」
lines.29: 「Whoa! What're you doing? I haven't had enough!」
lines.30: 「You're too young to drown your sorrows. Moron.」
lines.32: 「Jeez, you've had way too much. And quit chugging straight from the bottle, okay? Your only options are puke or die.」
lines.37: 「His taste in clothes sucks, so I gotta pick everything out for him!」
lines.39: 「He acts all cynical, but he's such a kid!」
lines.40: 「Seriously, there's nothin' but awful stuff about him!!」
lines.43: 「Even with all those awful things piling up in my head... even then, I...」
lines.44: 「I realized how I felt... after Otome and Leo started getting close...」
lines.47: 「Hey, don't yell. People live around here.」
lines.48: 「Maybe I should've just been born a guy!」
